Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description: Job Title: Senior Data Scientist Location: Guadalajara, Mexico, Hybrid This is a remote/hybrid position, which will require the ability to be onsite in our Guadalajara, Mexico office as needed. Candidates must be based in Guadalajara. ABOUT THE COMPANY: Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth. With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate. Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future. THE OPPORTUNITY: At Salesloft, our Senior Data Scientists will be pivotal to our company's success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing Data Science team, taking full ownership of projects that redefine how sellers work and drive revenue. We believe that the most innovative products have a passionate and supportive research team behind them. On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for exploring and applying the latest advances in AI to solve real-world challenges for our customers. Specifically, you will: Apply your expertise in agentic systems, NLP, and machine learning to build solutions that enhance the productivity and effectiveness of sales professionals. Design and run robust experiments, translating ambiguous problems into concrete research questions and prototypes. Collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering teams to ensure your research paves a clear path to production and delivers value to our users. Act as a thought leader and subject matter expert, identifying new opportunities for innovation and influencing the direction of our AI roadmap. In addition to working with amazing colleagues who live our core values every day, you will also have the opportunity to build revolutionary AI and ML systems that are changing the way sellers sell. You will have an opportunity to make a difference. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR: We are seeking a results-oriented, deeply curious, and strategic researcher who is passionate about owning their work and its impact. You are a leader and mentor who thrives on identifying gaps in knowledge and charting new paths for innovation. Specifically, you will play a pivotal role in helping us push the boundaries of what's possible in AI for sales by taking ownership of complex projects and seeing them through to completion. If you're looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more, then becoming a Senior Data Scientist is the career path for you! THE TEAM: Our Salesloft Data Science team is comprised of seasoned and up-and-coming Data Scientists. Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired. The Data Science team consists of collaborative and self-motivated individuals who are passionate about their craft. We operate in a dynamic environment where our project timelines more closely align with engineering sprints than academic papers. We value intellectual curiosity and encourage researchers to voice feedback and help prioritize projects that will have the biggest impact. THE SKILL SET: 5+ years of overall experience as an AI Researcher, Data Scientist, or ML Engineer 1+ years of experience with deploying ML/AI features in production Demonstrated experience owning and leading research projects, from initial scoping and experimental design to delivering prototypes or production-ready models. Deep expertise in AI agent systems, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and classic machine learning methodologies. Proven ability to mentor and provide constructive feedback to junior researchers, elevating the work of the entire team. Experience translating complex research findings into actionable insights for cross-functional partners in product and engineering. Superb communication skills; you must be able to articulate complex technical concepts and advocate for strategic research directions Familiarity with python for data processing, ML, AI agents Familiarity with frameworks for agentic AI (LangGraph, Google ADK, Open AI Agents SDK etc) At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you're excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us! Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Salesloft will come from an @salesloft.com email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official Careers Page (https://salesloft.com/company/careers/). We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment — all hiring decisions are made by people. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or prefer to opt out of any AI-assisted tools, please let your recruiter know. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.

Title: AI-Native Engineer – Agentic AI & Production Operations
Description: Job Description: AI-Native Engineer – Agentic AI & Production Operations Experience Level: Intermediate / Senior Job Type: Contract / Full-Time Role Overview We are seeking high-performing AI-Native Engineers at Intermediate and Senior levels to design, develop, deploy, operate, and continuously improve enterprise Generative AI, Agentic AI, Multi-Agent systems, and data-centric AI solutions. This role focuses on engineering and production operations rather than research or prompt engineering alone. Candidates will be responsible for the complete lifecycle of AI solutions, including development, integration, testing, deployment, monitoring, production support, incident resolution, data migration, and continuous evaluation. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Google Gemini, Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), Vertex AI, BigQuery, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, Python, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Key Responsibilities 1. Agentic AI Engineering Design, develop, deploy, and maintain production-grade Agentic AI and Multi-Agent systems. Implement supervisor/sub-agent orchestration, agent tools, custom extensions, and API integrations. Build reliable execution workflows with retries, fallbacks, error handling, and recovery mechanisms. Develop and optimize RAG pipelines, vector search, and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) workflows. Troubleshoot agent execution failures, looping behavior, and probabilistic output inconsistencies. Maintain and version prompts, configurations, tool definitions, and agent workflows. 2. Production Support and Operations Monitor production AI systems and perform regular operational health checks. Investigate incidents, analyze logs, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and implement corrective actions. Resolve API failures, quota limits, throttling, latency issues, and pipeline failures. Manage production deployments, shadow launches, rollback procedures, and configuration updates. Implement preventive measures to improve reliability, availability, and operational performance. 3. AI Observability and Monitoring Build and maintain observability frameworks for Agentic AI applications. Monitor agent latency, invocation counts, task completion rates, failure rates, routing accuracy, and fallback rates. Track LLM performance, token consumption, API errors, and quota utilization. Detect data quality issues, schema drift, prompt regressions, and model or extraction drift. Use monitoring and telemetry tools such as Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or equivalent platforms. 4. Data Engineering and Migration Develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines, data transformation workflows, and validation scripts. Support BigQuery migrations, legacy data modernization, schema changes, and semantic-layer migrations. Perform source-to-target data validation, reconciliation, and data integrity checks. Manage vector database migrations, RAG knowledge-base synchronization, and metadata updates. Implement data retention, archival, and purging policies. 5. RAG and Vector Database Operations Maintain ingestion, embedding, indexing, and retrieval pipelines. Perform re-indexing when source data changes and validate knowledge-base freshness. Troubleshoot retrieval failures, inaccurate context, metadata issues, and ranking anomalies. Maintain synchronization between source systems, BigQuery, and vector databases. Support automated RAG regression testing and retrieval-quality improvements. 6. Continuous Evaluation and Quality Assurance Establish and maintain golden datasets for continuous evaluation and benchmarking. Perform shadow-mode testing, side-by-side output validation, and automated prompt evaluations. Monitor hallucinations, output quality, behavioral drift, and Human-in-the-Loop acceptance rates. Identify issues across data, prompts, models, agent logic, retrieval, tools, infrastructure, and integrations. Develop automated testing frameworks to ensure consistent AI application performance. 7. Reliability, Security, and High Availability Implement timeouts, idempotency, retry policies, circuit breakers, dead-letter queues, and asynchronous processing. Support autoscaling, capacity planning, graceful degradation, and high-availability production services. Apply security controls, including IAM, RBAC/ACL, PII masking, secrets management, and audit logging. Ensure appropriate data protection, access controls, and compliance with enterprise retention policies. Required Technical Skills AI and Agentic Frameworks: Google Gemini, Google ADK, Vertex AI, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent agent frameworks. Programming: Strong Python development skills, REST/gRPC APIs, debugging, and software engineering fundamentals. Cloud and Data Platforms: GCP, BigQuery, ETL/ELT pipelines, data transformation, and schema management. RAG and Vector Databases: Vertex AI Vector Search, Pinecone, Chroma, or equivalent vector database technologies. Observability: Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or equivalent tools. DevOps and CI/CD: Docker, Git, automated testing, deployment pipelines, rollback strategies, and configuration versioning. Production Engineering: Incident management, RCA, performance optimization, reliability engineering, and continuous evaluation. Senior-Level Expectations Architect complex Multi-Agent systems and production-grade AI solutions. Lead incident resolution, root cause analysis, and preventive improvement initiatives. Define CI/CD, deployment safety, observability, and continuous evaluation standards. Drive migration architecture and resolve complex issues involving latency, quotas, model behavior, and data drift. Take end-to-end ownership of system reliability, scalability, and production readiness. Intermediate-Level Expectations Develop, test, deploy, and maintain Agentic AI applications under established engineering standards. Support production monitoring, incident triage, debugging, and root cause analysis. Maintain RAG pipelines, vector databases, data integrations, and evaluation workflows. Implement reliability controls, automated tests, and deployment procedures. Collaborate with senior engineers to improve system performance, security, and operational stability. Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering and cloud data engineering capabilities with hands-on experience operating AI applications in production. Candidates should demonstrate practical experience building Agentic AI workflows, troubleshooting real-world failures, improving observability, and maintaining reliable enterprise AI systems. Important: This is an engineering and production ownership role. Candidates with only theoretical AI knowledge, research-only experience, or prompt engineering experience without hands-on development and production support experience may not be suitable.
